ModMetaData.name: Mounted Arms: Strategic Missiles
ModMetaData.author: Felipe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds ballistic missile launchers that can strike targets on the world map, using Combat Extended's world shelling.
- Tactical ballistic missile launcher: a crewed launcher that fires a heavy guided missile at the local map or at settlements up to 120 world tiles away.
Planned: ICBM silo (conventional and nuclear warheads).
Requires Combat Extended. Companion to Mounted Arms, but does not depend on it.
